title: eupatorium angustilobum
intro: Eupatorium angustilobum, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Joe Pye Weed, is a perennial flowering plant in the sunflower family native to eastern Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Eupatorium angustilobum include its ability to act as a diaphoretic, inducing sweating to help lower body temperature, and its spasmolytic properties, which may help to relax muscles and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
